comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs remove a selected cartridge fuse using a puller.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert one blade beneath a locking tab and pull tool plus wire together vs grip a fuse in puller jaws and rock its two ends from spring clips.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal leaves its cavity without housing/crimp/neighbor damage vs correct fuse leaves both clips and rests in the tray without disturbing adjacent fuses.
comparison.reason: Both are selective tool-assisted extraction, but the candidate uniquely tests recessed latch defeat and maintained tool-wire co-withdrawal; the fuse task tests jaw capture and sequential levering.
